name: Beardd's Wayfarer: pins
author: Beardd (BearddOddity)
description: Your own places to go: right-click the local map for a destination (or a quest's location, or a dungeon's exit), middle-click a dungeon map to pin and name a spot, Follow a region-map waypoint; F1 drops a pin where you look, F3 cycles the quest and your places, Shift+F2 removes one. The compass, waypoint and trail follow the place.
